name: Roll a Fisherman 🎣
desc:
🎣 Welcome to Roll a Fisher!

How to play:
🎲 Roll a fisherman!
⚓ Place your fisherman on the dock!
🐟 Collect the fish and place it on the stand!
💵 Collect cash from the fish and UPGRADE!

💸 YOUR FISH EARNS EVEN WHILE YOU ARE OFFLINE! 💸
